children: Tesla (TSLA) started high-volume production and initial deliveries of its electric Semi at the new Sparks, Nevada plant. Facility spans ~1.7M sq ft with annual capacity up to 50,000 units.
Tesla (TSLA) launched Semi with two trims: Standard Range and Long Range. Long Range claims 500 miles per charge and a listed price of $290,000. Factory capacity up to 50,000 trucks/year.
UBS estimates Tesla (TSLA) will deliver ~470,000 vehicles in Q3, down 5% year-over-year, about 1% below Q2 and near the midpoint of external forecasts.
Tesla (TSLA): CEO Elon Musk says Full Self‑Driving for the Tesla Semi should arrive soon, possibly by year‑end or early next year, noting autonomy is vital for trucking.
On TSLA Q4 2025 call, CEO Elon Musk said Tesla will build lithium refineries and cathode plants to secure battery supply as external suppliers aren’t scaling fast enough.
Belgian tests of Tesla FSD over ~400 km found repeated speed-limit errors: FSD averaged 44 km/h in 30 km/h zones, exceeded 20 km/h limits in 42% of residential areas and misread signs.
ZET SCALE selected Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) as its primary OEM for an initial order of 2,500 Tesla Semi trucks and stated plans to place orders exceeding 10,000 electric trucks from multiple providers.
UBS maintained a Neutral rating on Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) and set a $385 price target, with the firm noting the target is near Tesla, Inc. (TSLA)’s current trading level.
Tesla (TSLA) opened its Texas cathode plant and used its locally made cathode material to build the first Cybercab, linking plant output directly to that vehicle's production.
Tesla (TSLA) expands Full Self-Driving in Europe: Czechia approved FSD, France started road tests, and Ireland joins EU-wide rollout efforts ahead of a possible approval vote next month.
